Start the race weekend from your wheel, with Factory Seat 1.5.

- **Start race weekend button (Factory Seat 1.5).** Map a key or wheel button in SimHub's **Controls and events** to the new action **FactorySeatPlugin.StartRaceWeekend**. When the overlay reads **START RACE WEEKEND**, press it, and within a second or two Factory Seat starts the weekend and the overlay moves on to READY TO RACE. You no longer have to leave LMU to do it. Thanks to the Factory Seat developer, who wrote this feature.
- **How it works, and what it writes.** This is the only thing the companion writes, and only when you press the button. It writes one small file, `start-weekend.request`, next to `briefing.json`, holding only your career's id. It only writes it when Factory Seat is running with your career open and the next round (or test day) is waiting to start. A press at any other time does nothing. Factory Seat deletes the file and ignores any request older than a minute, so a stray press never starts a weekend later. Older Factory Seat versions ignore the file.

Works with Factory Seat 1.1 to 1.5. The button needs 1.5; everything else works as before on 1.1 and later. The overlay size is unchanged (720×476).
